description: This file defines a set of React components for an Alert Dialog UI, wrapping Radix UI primitives to provide customizable alert dialog elements such as overlay, content, header, footer, title, description, action, and cancel buttons.

classes.name: AlertDialog
classes.description: Main component that provides context for the alert dialog, rendering the root of the dialog using Radix UI primitives.

classes.name: AlertDialogTrigger
classes.description: Component to trigger the display of the alert dialog.

classes.name: AlertDialogPortal
classes.description: Component providing the portal container for rendering overlay and content outside the DOM hierarchy.

classes.name: AlertDialogOverlay
classes.description: Component representing the semi-transparent overlay behind the dialog, with animated fading effects.

classes.name: AlertDialogContent
classes.description: The main content area of the dialog, including animations, positioning, and styling.

classes.name: AlertDialogHeader
classes.description: Container component for dialog header content.

classes.name: AlertDialogFooter
classes.description: Container component for dialog footer actions.

classes.name: AlertDialogTitle
classes.description: Component for the dialog's title text.

classes.name: AlertDialogDescription
classes.description: Component for descriptive text within the dialog.

classes.name: AlertDialogAction
classes.description: Styled button component representing the primary action.

classes.name: AlertDialogCancel
classes.description: Styled button component representing the cancel action, with outline variant.

methods.name: cn
methods.description: Utility function for concatenating class names conditionally.

methods.name: buttonVariants
methods.description: Function returning className strings for button styling based on variants.
